truth: Publishing destinations consume exported artifacts and metadata packets. They never mutate source lanes, proxy media, edit decisions, crop recipes, or transcript truth.
operatorRule: Use this catalog before preparing platform copy, upload packets, dry-run workers, or manual publishing checklists.
sharedRequirements: Every publish record should reference a delivery lane id, exported artifact path, title, description or show notes, visibility intent, schedule intent, and receipt status.
Manual upload and API upload paths should use the same packet metadata so receipts can be reconciled later.
Dry-run workers may validate artifacts and metadata contracts but must not upload, schedule, publish, create provider receipts, or create public URLs.

destinations.label: YouTube episode
humanChecklist: Confirm the 16:9 master plays correctly.
Confirm title, description, thumbnail, and visibility.
Confirm schedule or publish-now intent.
Copy provider video id and public URL back into the publish receipt.
destinations.agentGuidance: Prepare concise title/description options and verify packet completeness. Do not publish without explicit human approval.

destinations.label: Patreon episode post
humanChecklist: Confirm patron-facing copy and tier visibility.
Confirm whether the post embeds YouTube, uploads video, attaches audio, or links to the episode page.
Copy Patreon post id and URL back into the publish receipt.
destinations.agentGuidance: Draft member-facing context and summarize what patrons get. Keep tier decisions explicit and inspectable.

destinations.label: YouTube Short
humanChecklist: Confirm the 9:16 short starts fast and captions are readable.
Confirm title/hashtags and schedule.
Copy provider video id and URL back into the publish receipt.
destinations.agentGuidance: Create short-specific hook/title options from the transcript segment. Do not reuse long episode copy unchanged.

destinations.label: Instagram Reel
humanChecklist: Confirm vertical crop, captions, and safe text placement.
Confirm caption and hashtags match Instagram tone.
Copy post URL back into the publish receipt.
destinations.agentGuidance: Prefer punchy captions and avoid platform-incompatible links in primary caption copy.

destinations.label: Facebook Reel
humanChecklist: Confirm vertical playback and captions.
Confirm page/audience target.
Copy post URL back into the publish receipt.
destinations.agentGuidance: Keep copy accessible and slightly more context-rich than Instagram when useful.

destinations.label: LinkedIn video
humanChecklist: Confirm the clip has professional context, not just a raw social caption.
Confirm the aspect ratio is appropriate for the target post.
Copy post URL back into the publish receipt.
destinations.agentGuidance: Frame the post around a useful idea, lesson, or discussion prompt.

destinations.label: Spotify podcast episode
humanChecklist: Confirm the audio master plays cleanly.
Confirm title, show notes, and episode metadata.
Copy provider episode id and URL back into the publish receipt.
destinations.agentGuidance: Prepare show notes from the transcript and manuscript context. Keep audio-specific metadata separate from video copy.

destinations.label: Apple Podcasts episode
humanChecklist: Confirm audio metadata and show notes match podcast feed requirements.
Confirm release timing matches Spotify and episode page timing.
Copy provider episode id and URL back into the publish receipt.
destinations.agentGuidance: Treat Apple and Spotify as separate receipts even if they share one audio master and show-notes draft.
